battery.chemistry.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists the LYRIQ-V (MY26) cells as GM Ultium 140Ah NMC pouch. GM describes Ultium cells as NCMA (NMC family with aluminium), closest enum value nmc. charge_port.notes: Page: the 2026 car kept its CCS1 port (US). thinkEV (Canada) says the 2027 LYRIQ trades the CCS connector on current models for NACS; EVChargingStations says earlier years used CCS1. Conflicts with OpenEV (nacs, probably 2027 data). No Canadian GM page read.
